quest.title: Low-Temperature Warning
quest.description: Iris has a warning for you regarding Dragonspine's low temperatures...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Excuse me? Did you want something?

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Cold is the norm when you're up a mountain like this one.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: You look like a Traveler. So, are you planning on scaling the mountain?

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Fair enough. I'm not going to try and stop you... I've met my fair share of travelers and whatever you say, there's no dissuading them.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: All I will say, if you're serious about this, is to keep an eye on your <color=#00E1FFFF>body temperature</color> at all times.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: If your temperature drops too low, not only will it slow you down, but you can also injure yourself. And if you're unlucky enough to get attacked by a monster in that state... Well, that's the last situation you'd want to find yourself in.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: So, if your temperature drops dangerously low, get yourself to a <color=#00E1FFFF>source of heat</color> and warm back up while you plan your next move.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: In short, and I know you've probably heard this plenty of times, but it's true: This is, by far, the most dangerous place in all of Mondstadt. When you're climbing a mountain, you must always plan your movements carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: I've seen more than a few adventurers lose their lives because they didn't think before they acted...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Alright, I won't lecture you any longer. Just be sure to prepare before you set out.
